# Return - Meditation Timer (Complete Documentation)

> A minimal, zen-like meditation timer designed for deep focus and Apple ecosystem integration

For summary version, see: [llms.txt](https://941return.com/llms.txt)

## Product Overview

Return is a beautifully minimal meditation timer app that helps users build consistent meditation practices. With immersive video themes, ambient soundscapes, and deep Apple Health integration, Return transforms any device into a serene meditation space.

## Core Features

### Immersive Themes (4 Total)
- **Water**: Flowing streams and gentle water sounds
- **Fire**: Warm flames with crackling ambience
- **Forest**: Natural woodland with bird songs
- **Silence**: Pure minimalism for focused practice

Each theme includes:
- Full-screen video backgrounds
- Ambient audio loops
- Matched visual aesthetics

### Meditation Timer
- Duration: 5-60 minutes in 5-minute increments
- Bell sounds: 3 customizable options
- Repeat modes: Once, Until Stopped, Until Time, Specific Count
- Gentle fade-in/fade-out transitions

### Apple Health Integration
**Reads during sessions**:
- Heart rate
- Heart rate variability (HRV)
- Respiratory rate

**Logs after sessions**:
- Mindful minutes
- Session duration
- Timestamp and duration

### Cross-Device Experience
- **iPhone/iPad**: Full immersive experience with video themes
- **Apple Watch**: Standalone app, haptic bells, heart rate during session
- **Mac**: Native app with all features
- **Apple TV**: Big-screen meditation for living room practice
- **iCloud Sync**: Settings and history across all devices

### Live Activities
- Lock Screen timer display
- Dynamic Island integration
- Real-time countdown without opening app

## Pricing Model

- **Free**: Basic timer with Water theme
- **In-App Purchase** (one-time): Unlocks all 4 themes, all bell sounds, and advanced features
- **No Subscription**: Buy once, own forever

## Technical Details

### iOS App
- SwiftUI native interface
- SwiftData for local storage
- HealthKit integration
- AVFoundation for audio/video
- WatchConnectivity for Apple Watch

### Marketing Website
- FastAPI backend
- HTMX + Alpine.js frontend
- Bootstrap 5 styling
- Markdown blog with SQLite storage
- Resend email integration
- 941analytics custom analytics

### Performance
- Optimized video loading
- Web Audio API for seamless loops
- Lazy-loaded images
- Critical CSS inlining

## Target Audience

- Meditation beginners seeking guided structure
- Experienced practitioners wanting minimal distraction
- Athletes using meditation for performance
- Health-conscious individuals tracking biometrics
- Apple ecosystem users wanting cross-device sync

## App Store

- Available on iOS App Store
- Requires iOS 17.0+, watchOS 10.0+, macOS 14.0+, tvOS 17.0+
